sam: heads up, saw a p95 latency spike on sm110 nodes after yesterday's runtime deploy (~14:20 UTC). kernel chooser flipped to fallback path for small seqs, p95 +30%.
ingrid: can you paste the log lines you saw? :eyes:
sam: sure, snippet:
```
[2025-06-21T14:19:58Z] device-probe: cudaSmVersion=110, tensor_cores=true, bf16_supported=false
[2025-06-21T14:19:58Z] kernel-chooser: picked tc_bf16_fastpath for seq=32
[2025-06-21T14:19:58Z] exec: assert failed -> falling back to generic_kernel (slowpath)
```
anya: whoa bf16_supported=false on sm110? that seems off, we expect bf16 on these cards. maybe driver mismatch or probe bug.
darren: agreed. device-probe reported mixed flags on a subset of nodes. I grep'd /var/log/runtime-probe on one host:
```
# /opt/runtime/probe --dump
sm_version=110
tensor_cores=1
bf16=0
fp8=0
```
That explains the pick -> runtime tries tc_bf16 path then hits a kernel assert and falls back.
sam: attached a tiny profile from the canary run:
```
sm110_seq32_kern_choice:
  tc_bf16: est 0.60ms (10k iters)
  fallback_generic: 2.10ms
p95 before: 12.4ms
p95 after: 16.1ms
```
ingrid: reproduce instructions?
sam: run: ./tools/runtime-stress --model llama2 --seq 32 --batch 8 --device sm110 --kernel-hint=auto
anya: quick mitigation: mark sm110 pool with capflag sm110.force_no_tc=true so chooser avoids tc_bf16. rolling as a stopgap :thumbsup:
darren: long-term we should add probe hysteresis and probe-aggregation. right now a single misreported probe flips production kernel path.
anya: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 -> sm110-probe-hysteresis + kvcache-evict-threshold. includes unit tests and microbench results.
sam: proposal for hysteresis: require mean improvement >10% over N=20 samples and stable for 5m before switching kernel path. also keep last-known-good fallback for 10m to avoid oscillation.
darren: also observed kvcache churn on these small-seq workloads: prefetcher misestimates and evicts useful entries -> cache miss spikes = higher latency. adding small fixed eviction_threshold for sm110 improved hit rate in local bench.
ingrid: runtime-ci: can you kick a canary with PR #842 applied to sm110 pool and run the perf-suite?
runtime-ci: deploy-bot: rolled runtime v2.14.3 -> canary (sm110) at 2025-06-21T15:05:00Z. perf-suite scheduled.
sam: after canary, p95 dropped back to ~13.4ms but still ~8% above baseline. looks better but not perfect, likely need kvcache tweak + kernel selection tweak together.
anya: benchmark snapshot attached in PR. summary: hysteresis prevents flip on 1/100 bad probes, kvcache-threshold gains ~6% p95 on seq32 synthetic.
darren: next steps: (1) merge PR after a 24h canary, (2) add telemetry: probe-confidence, probe-count, kernel_switch_reason -> for debugging, (3) add a small roll-forward if p95 regresses more than 15%.
sam: scheduling perf-run 2025-06-22 09:00 PT. tagging @eng-sre to monitor node-level metrics and driver versions. thanks all :heart:
